_what: Surveyed reservoirs with published stage/area/storage figures, for scoring the pondage screen against something real rather than against a synthetic fixture.
_why: Every other headline number in HydroRecon is measured against reality — flow against 69 DHM gauges, capacity against 104 commissioned plants, head against two terrain products. Pondage was measured against an 18-cell bowl whose answer was true by construction. This is the reference set that changes that.
_caution: A modern DEM over an EXISTING reservoir samples the water surface, not the drowned valley. So these sites test the fill, the barrier and the shoreline integration against a real, complex shoreline at a known level; they cannot test the stage-storage relation below that level, because no bathymetry is present in the raster. Read `test` on each entry for what it is actually claiming.

reservoirs.name: Kulekhani (Indrasarobar)
reservoirs.damCoordinateNote: 27°35′25″N 85°9′21″E as published, converted to decimal degrees.
reservoirs.sourceNote: Secondary source compiling World Bank project documentation. Good enough to falsify a screening tool by a factor of two; NOT good enough to calibrate one. Replace with the NEA/DoED design report if it can be obtained.
reservoirs.testNote: The reservoir predates every DEM the app uses, so the raster carries its water surface as a flat plateau. Filling from a seed in that plateau to the plateau's own elevation should reproduce the published 2.2 km2 surface area. That scores the connected fill, the dam barrier and the area integration against a real shoreline. It does not score storage: the volume below the water surface is not in the raster, so a predicted storage here is a lower bound on the published 85.3 Mm3 by construction, not an error.
